name: PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Atlantis Subsea Indonesia Tbk engages in the provision of multi-disciplinary survey support and solutions for the oil and gas, energy and renewable energy, and marine infrastructure sectors in Indonesia. It offers post construction support, inspection repair maintenance support, construction support, survey and positioning, geophysical and geotechnical survey, and ROV support services. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.
